title: Ulap Digital Twin: a 6G propagation study pipeline
description:
Reproducible radio-frequency digital twins for 6G deployment planning. National geoportal shapefiles, satellite imagery and LiDAR building heights go in; ray-traced coverage, SINR, mmWave and drive-test studies come out, via BlenderGIS to Mitsuba to NVIDIA Sionna RT. Everything runs on CPU: no CUDA required.

The pilot study twins the Newton / Rising Sun area of south-central Barbados and ray-traces 1.8 to 60 GHz. The pipeline is not Barbados-specific: ulap-scope init defines a study anywhere in the world, and examples/data/fetch_open_scene.py builds a scene for any coordinate from OpenStreetMap footprints and open elevation tiles.

This archive ships code, not data. No Barbados Geoportal layer, and no artefact derived from one, is included; every geospatial layer is fetched or supplied by the user at run time. See DATA.md in the archive for the per-layer data availability statement.
